end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and identifying triangles and squares, including when shapes were turned or tilted. Ayaan used the method of counting where the lines meet and later corrected the quick answer of six to three. At home, ask them to find shapes around the room and count their sides and corners aloud.
